description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). A fresh database with the round-2 shapes renamed: YA(k non-unique index: keys 1, 2, 1; t 'a1' to 'a3') and YB(k non-unique index: keys 2, 1, 1, 3; u 'b1' to 'b4') as MA and MB; and YP (ID primary key, N, G, s; the round-1 rows, an index on N). Statements: YA INNER JOIN YB and YB INNER JOIN YA (repeat of join-dups-both-indexed); YA INNER JOIN YB WHERE YA.k >= 1 (a WHERE on an indexed join key); SELECT ID, s FROM YP and ... WHERE N >= 3 (repeat of single-pk-indexes). Each of SELECT t, u FROM YA INNER JOIN YB ON YA.k = YB.k; SELECT t, u FROM YB INNER JOIN YA ON YA.k = YB.k; SELECT t, u FROM YA INNER JOIN YB ON YA.k = YB.k WHERE YA.k >= 1; SELECT ID, s FROM YP; SELECT ID, s FROM YP WHERE N >= 3 opened as a dynaset and then as a snapshot, all rows read. Asks whether a join's dynaset comes in its snapshot's order or in another (a key order of either table).
